title: Persist benchmark run reports for comparable T0/T1/T2
description:
Purpose: `benchmark:run` currently prints metrics to stdout only. Persist a versioned JSON report (scanner git sha, corpus annotation version, review states, per-repo and aggregate scores, per-case outcomes) and ingest that record into Plexus as an Evaluation with custom metrics (warehouse slice A).

Exclusions:
- Item-per-annotation first-class detector eval (Plexus slice B)
- Changing ground-truth YAML
- New detector families

Definition of Done:
- `benchmark:run --output <path>` writes a schema-versioned JSON report
- Unit tests cover report shape and aggregation
- A Plexus Evaluation can be created from that JSON without calling Score.predict()
- T0 (current mismatch) is stored as a replayable run

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Superseded as the Plexus integration approach. Agreed path is DATAP-bd3b69: Python Score + plexus evaluate accuracy against local GraphQL, not persisting stdout JSON via evaluation.ingest. Keep this issue only if a local report file is still wanted as a CLI convenience; it is not the Plexus store.
